run_IMDB_main: run the IMDB dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_IMDB_dataset: create an IMDB classification dataset instance with negative and positive sentiment labels
load_IMDB_dataset: load the HuggingFace IMDB dataset using datasets.load_dataset for sentiment classification tasks
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace IMDB dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
get_train_test_lines: get train and test line tuples from the IMDB dataset using the map function
